decisions.reason: A niche agricultural crate that is only mentioned on the website gives limited evidence of meeting aspirations, but the large firm has the slack to carry it a while longer.
Foldable large containers are core to returnable packaging and have a dedicated page, which suggests results satisfactory against aspirations.
Stackable crates fit the standard range and carry little cost, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for alternatives.
A medium-duty rackable pallet fills a gap in the pallet range, and slack allows the firm to keep it while results are still uncertain.
The spill-retention pallet has a dedicated page and serves a specialized industrial need, indicating adequate performance.
The pallet with load retainers is featured on its own page and supports automotive and industrial handling, so management sees no reason to drop it.
